edges.reason: buyTokens calls _preValidatePurchase before computing token amounts
buyTokens calls _getTokenAmount which performs multiplication with the rate
buyTokens calls _processPurchase to deliver tokens
buyTokens calls _forwardFunds which performs an external ether transfer
buyTokens is guarded by the nonReentrant modifier
Payable fallback forwards msg.sender into buyTokens
_processPurchase delegates token delivery to _deliverTokens
_deliverTokens invokes SafeERC20.safeTransfer on the token
safeTransfer routes the call through callOptionalReturn which performs a low-level call
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call to the token address allowing reentrancy
sendValue forwards all gas to recipient via call.value, enabling reentrant callbacks
_forwardFunds transfers msg.value to _wallet through an external call
_forwardFunds reads the _wallet state variable as transfer destination
_deliverTokens uses the _token state variable as call target
_getTokenAmount multiplies weiAmount by the _rate state variable
buyTokens updates _weiRaised with SafeMath.add
nonReentrant reads and writes the _notEntered lock flag
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value
buyTokens derives the purchaser from the untrusted msg.sender
beneficiary parameter is validated inside _preValidatePurchase
beneficiary parameter is consumed by buyTokens for token delivery
weiAmount parameter flows into the tokens local through _getTokenAmount
weiAmount parameter is added to _weiRaised inside buyTokens
tokens local is passed to _processPurchase for delivery
rate constructor parameter is assigned to _rate
wallet constructor parameter is assigned to _wallet
token constructor parameter is assigned to _token
Crowdsale constructor writes the _rate state variable
Crowdsale constructor writes the _wallet state variable
Crowdsale constructor writes the _token state variable
_mint increases _totalSupply using SafeMath.add
_mint increases the recipient entry in _balances
_transfer updates sender and recipient entries in _balances with sub and add
transferFrom decreases the spender entry in _allowances
AllCrowdsale constructor assigns the deployed KappaCrowdsale to kappa_sale
AllCrowdsale constructor assigns the deployed GammaCrowdsale to gamma_sale

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter beneficiary is only consumed by buyTokens and its helpers, so it can be folded into the function node
Parameter weiAmount is the purchase value processed solely inside buyTokens and can be folded into the function node
Local variable tokens is produced by _getTokenAmount and carries its arithmetic result, so it merges into that function
Parameter rate is only used to initialize _rate inside the Crowdsale constructor
Parameter wallet is only used to initialize _wallet inside the Crowdsale constructor
Parameter token is only used to initialize _token inside the Crowdsale constructor
